# Wodore

> Wodore is the international hut directory: an interactive map with
> opening seasons, capacities, availability and booking sources for
> mountain huts, bivouacs and shelters.

Web app: {{ frontend_url }}
Hut pages: {{ frontend_url }}/{lang}/hut/{slug} for lang in
  en, de, fr, it — each serves the page with localized metadata. The
  bare {{ frontend_url }}/hut/{slug} is the app's user-facing alias
  (the app strips the prefix after loading; display language follows
  the stored user preference first, then the path)

## Places

- Place detail (Markdown): {{ api_base }}/v1/geo/places/{slug}.md
- Place metadata (JSON): {{ api_base }}/v1/geo/places/{slug}/meta
- Category index (Markdown): {{ api_base }}/v1/categories/index.md

## API

- OpenAPI documentation: {{ api_base }}/v1/docs
- OpenAPI schema (JSON): {{ api_base }}/v1/openapi.json
- Hut list (JSON): {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/huts
- Hut detail (JSON): {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/{slug}?lang=de|en|fr|it
- Hut detail (Markdown): {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/{slug}.md?lang=de|en|fr|it
- Hut detail (Markdown, canonical URL): {{ frontend_url }}/hut/{slug}.md?lang=de|en|fr|it
- Sitemap: {{ frontend_url }}/sitemap.xml

## Finding huts

- By name (fuzzy, all languages): {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/search?q=rotond
- By map area: filter the hut/place listings to a bounding box with
  bbox=minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat (WGS84) — e.g.
  {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/huts.geojson?bbox=7.6,45.9,8.1,46.2
  (accepted on hut search, hut list, both GeoJSON dumps and place
  search; paginate with offset and limit)

## Live availability

Bed availability per hut and day, aggregated from booking sources
(SAC, HRS, ...):

- One hut, next 7 days (JSON):
  {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/{slug}/availability/today?days=7
- Many huts at once (GeoJSON):
  {{ api_base }}/v1/huts/availability/weekend.geojson?days=2&slugs=aarbiwak,rotondohuette

Dates accept ISO (2026-07-18), European (18.07.2026) or the keywords
now, today and weekend. Each day carries free/total beds,
occupancy_status (empty | low | medium | high | full) and
reservation_status (possible | not_possible | not_online | unknown).

## About the data

Hut descriptions come from their respective sources (for example SAC-CAS)
and are reproduced with attribution — keep the attribution line when
quoting. Hut data is aggregated from public sources (OpenStreetMap, SAC,
Alpsonline/HRS, refuges.info, Wikidata and others); the `sources` field
of each hut lists provenance and deep links.

## Usage

All endpoints listed here are public and read-only. Responses are
cacheable (ETag / Last-Modified where available). Please identify
yourself with a reasonable User-Agent and keep request rates modest
(around one request per second).
